add_api_endpoint.name: add_validated_api_endpoint
add_api_endpoint.description: Add a new API endpoint following existing patterns while explicitly validating all input and rejecting unknown fields.
add_api_endpoint.when_to_use: When a user requests addition of any new HTTP endpoint to the service.
steps: Read similar routes and the shared validation helper to copy the exact input-validation pattern that rejects unknown fields.
Write a failing test first that covers the happy path plus explicit validation cases for missing, malformed and unknown fields.
Implement the route handler using the validation helper before any business logic.
Register the route in the router.
Run the targeted tests and confirm all validation cases pass.

errors_and_fixes.error: treating validation as optional or adding it after the handler logic
errors_and_fixes.fix: always read the validation helper first and write validation tests before writing any handler code
